meta.titulo: Porsche restoration and personalisation · Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Complete Porsche restoration, backdating, restomod and bespoke projects, retaining maximum originality or incorporating modern engineering.

parrafos: Each Porsche is the representation of values, an attitude and a way of conceiving specific driving. The brand presents timeless elegance and beauty and we feel it is our duty to make these principles endure.
That is why at Valentín Motors we seek to recover originality in restoration projects and add new values in customization projects.

Our restorations are marked by the maximum index of
originality and quality in all aspects of the project.

In comprehensive restorations we seek to obtain the Certificate of
Authenticity, bringing the vehicle to its original specifications.

We analyze with the client the possibilities and scope
of the unit so that the result is proportional to the
future value of each Porsche classic model.

Each model and condition is analyzed at 100% so that
the final result be effective and consistent with the story.
Follow the restoration of this backdating of 964
Follow the restoration of this 2.7 s Targa from 1975
Follow the restoration of this SC Targa from 1979 that we are preparing for sale.
Follow the restoration of this beautiful 930, which arrived at our facilities after having suffered a fire in the engine area.

We carry out custom projects for clients with specific aspirations:
changes in the body, performance improvements, custom interiors..

Part of our time is dedicated to research, detecting trends and implementing improvements to our processes. We are constantly documenting ourselves, attending fairs, talking with other professionals in the sector to provide innovative solutions to our clients.

For those customers who want to combine the aesthetics of a classic model and the technological advances of a more recent vehicle, backdating may be an option. Taking advantage of the similar configurations of the 911 aircooled, we can transform the aesthetic characteristics of a more modern model, bringing it closer to the design of a previous unit: an SC with air conditioning or with a 3.2 engine? It is possible.
These transformations are always carried out taking into account that the new vehicle is homologable.
You will discover in Valentín Motors the perfect ally to carry them out: we have the knowledge of the brand, the proven experience and sensitivity to put ourselves in your shoes.
